about: The order work is taken in, written down once (owner, Nov 10, 2026: "does it have weights on what should be done first?"). `npm run pool -- next` sorts by it and the index's Ready by model lists follow it. Change the order here, never in a prompt.
sortBy: priority: 1 before 2 before 3. Priority 1 is a red on main or what the owner asked for now.
class: rules, checks and skills first; then the critical path; then what stops play; then the rest.
unblocks: the item more live items wait on comes first.
effort: low before medium before high.
size: S before M before L.
id: alphabetical, so the order is the same for everyone.

play.why: Owner, Nov 10: "the stuff I actually click and play". Player-facing items only.

classes.name: rules-checks-skills
classes.why: Owner, Nov 10: any rule, check or skill merges first, because everything built after it is held to it.

classes.name: critical-path
classes.why: The four pieces the owner's Nov 9 answers put first (the acceptance rule, the country tier and its clock, the life record, the words machine) and the audit's seven top root causes.

classes.name: stops-play
classes.why: Owner, Oct 24: "I still can't play the game." The play-first lane's items, in the order docs/play-first/ORDER.md gives.
